title: Rubric criterion Pass with acknowledged failures: no-test-regression
description: no-test-regression was passed with acknowledged_failures noting that patch_file_tests.rs was edited to add a new test. An additive new test mandated by the spec is not a test regression; the acknowledged_failures field was incorrectly populated, causing rubric-qualification: Fail.
proposed_resolution: Re-evaluate no-test-regression strictly as pass without acknowledged_failures when the only test-file change is an additive new test required by the specification. The acknowledged_failures mechanism applies to failures, not to spec-mandated additions.
